text:
Q: What is aSK//YOUTH AI?
A: aSK//YOUTH AI is an AI-powered platform built for the Sangguniang Kabataan (SK) of Barangay Concepcion Dos, Marikina City. It helps SK officials manage events, track attendance, generate documents, and allows youth constituents to query SK programs and submit suggestions — all in one unified system.

Q: How do I view upcoming SK events?
A: Ask the AI Assistant: "What are the upcoming SK events?" It will display real-time event information from our official database. Registered youth can also see events directly from their dashboard.

Q: How does QR attendance scanning work?
A: Each SK event has a unique QR code generated by the system. When you scan the QR code using your phone's camera or the in-app QR Scanner, your attendance is automatically recorded in real-time. Registered SK members have their account linked; guests enter their name and details manually on the scan screen.

Q: What should I do if the QR code won't scan?
A: First, ensure your camera is focused and there is good lighting. If the problem persists, ask the SK officer in charge to rotate/refresh the QR code for that event. You can also approach any SK officer present to have your attendance manually logged.

Q: How do I submit a suggestion or feedback to the SK?
A: Navigate to the "Suggestions" module in the sidebar. Type your suggestion, select a category (e.g., Health, Sports, Community), and submit. SK officers and the Chairperson can review and respond to your suggestion. Submissions can be anonymous.

Q: What is the ABYIP?
A: ABYIP stands for Annual Barangay Youth Investment Program. It is the official budget plan for SK-funded youth programs for the year. It outlines all planned projects, their objectives, target beneficiaries, and allocated budgets. You can ask the AI Assistant about specific ABYIP projects by name.

Q: Can I ask the AI about past SK programs and budgets?
A: Yes! The AI Assistant is knowledgeable about general SK programs and services. For more specific historical program details and budget breakdowns, those may be available to SK officers. Feel free to ask — the assistant will provide what it is authorized to share based on your role.

Q: Where do I find events happening near me?
A: All SK events are held within Barangay Concepcion Dos, Marikina City, unless otherwise specified. Check the "Event Management" module or ask the AI Assistant: "Are there any events this month?" for a complete list with locations.

Q: What is the Sangguniang Kabataan (SK)?
A: The Sangguniang Kabataan (SK) is the youth council in each barangay in the Philippines. It represents the youth, creates programs for development, and gives young people a voice in local governance.

Q: Is aSK//YOUTH AI free to use?
A: Yes! The aSK//YOUTH AI platform is completely free to use for all youth constituents and guests of Barangay Concepcion Dos.

Q: Can I chat with the assistant in Filipino?
A: Yes, you can! The AI Assistant is bilingual and can understand and respond in both English and Filipino/Tagalog.

Q: How do I contact the SK office directly?
A: You can visit the SK Hall at the Barangay Concepcion Dos center, or use the 'Suggestions' feature to send a direct message. For urgent matters, please refer to the official contact numbers posted on the barangay bulletin.

Q: How do I add or edit an FAQ entry?
A: Log in with an Admin, Chairman, or Officer account. Navigate to the FAQ module in the sidebar. Click '+ New FAQ' to add an entry, or 'Edit' on an existing one. You can set the visibility to 'public' (visible to everyone) or 'restricted' (visible only to officers and admins).

Q: How do I manage event categories, including 'Others'?
A: When creating or editing an event, select the category from the dropdown. If you select 'Others', a new field will appear allowing you to specify a custom category label (e.g., 'Relief Operation').
